/*@ With (A:list fp32) (c:fp32)
 Require 0 < batch && batch <= 18446744073709551603 && batch % 4 == 0 &&
 params != 0 && input_a != 0 && input_b != 0 && output != 0 &&
 FloatArray::full(input_a,batch/4+3,A) * store(input_b,float,c) * FloatArray::undef_full(output,batch/4)
 Ensure FloatArray::full(input_a,batch/4+3,A) * store(input_b,float,c) *
 FloatArray::full(output,batch/4,vmulc_values(batch/4,A,c)) */

/*@ Assert batch == batch@pre && params == params@pre && input_b == input_b@pre && fp32_bits_equal(b,c) &&
 0 < (batch@pre/4) && (batch@pre/4) <= 4611686018427387900 && input_a == input_a@pre && output == output@pre &&
 n == (batch@pre/4) && rvv_length(A) == (batch@pre/4)+3 &&
 FloatArray::full(input_a@pre,(batch@pre/4)+3,A) * store(input_b@pre,float,c) * FloatArray::undef_full(output,(batch@pre/4)) */
/*@ Inv batch == batch@pre && params == params@pre && input_b == input_b@pre && fp32_bits_equal(b,c) &&
 0 < (batch@pre/4) && (batch@pre/4) <= 4611686018427387900 && 0 <= n && n <= (batch@pre/4) && rvv_length(A) == (batch@pre/4)+3 &&
 input_a == pointer_offset(input_a@pre,((batch@pre/4)-n),float) && output == pointer_offset(output@pre,((batch@pre/4)-n),float) &&
 FloatArray::full(input_a@pre,(batch@pre/4)+3,A) * store(input_b@pre,float,c) *
 FloatArray::seg(output@pre,0,((batch@pre/4)-n),vmulc_values(((batch@pre/4)-n),A,c)) * FloatArray::undef_seg(output@pre,((batch@pre/4)-n),(batch@pre/4)) */

/*@ Assert batch == batch@pre && params == params@pre && input_b == input_b@pre && fp32_bits_equal(b,c) &&
 0 < (batch@pre/4) && (batch@pre/4) <= 4611686018427387900 && 0 <= n && n <= (batch@pre/4) && rvv_length(A) == (batch@pre/4)+3 &&
 input_a == pointer_offset(input_a@pre,((batch@pre/4)-n),float) && output == pointer_offset(output@pre,((batch@pre/4)-n),float) && 0 < n && 0 < vl && vl <= 32 && vl <= n && vl == vadd_vl(n) &&
 FloatArray::seg(input_a@pre,0,((batch@pre/4)-n),rvv_slice(0,((batch@pre/4)-n),A)) *
 FloatArray::full(input_a,vl,rvv_slice(((batch@pre/4)-n),(((batch@pre/4)-n)+vl),A)) *
 FloatArray::seg(input_a@pre,(((batch@pre/4)-n)+vl),(batch@pre/4)+3,rvv_slice((((batch@pre/4)-n)+vl),(batch@pre/4)+3,A)) *
 store(input_b@pre,float,c) *
 FloatArray::seg(output@pre,0,((batch@pre/4)-n),vmulc_values(((batch@pre/4)-n),A,c)) *
 FloatArray::undef_full(output,vl) *
 FloatArray::undef_seg(output@pre,(((batch@pre/4)-n)+vl),(batch@pre/4)) */
